known_limitations: All HTTP and GUI evidence in this sample is a local fixture, not installed Chrome or live Cloudflare.
Partial runtime: supported exercise IDs are listed in coverage.
Exercise mutations are disabled during Test It, including Pause. Only explicitly consented setup uploads are permitted.
Background IPC responses are application evidence, not raw provider HTTP responses.
Direct HTTP capture currently covers listing/stat paths only; internal retries are unavailable.
Previously running operations are not cancelled or attributed to Test It.
No disk SHA-256, exercise-mutation readback, archive manifest, rendered-media or live-provider acceptance is claimed; setup alone verifies fresh remote fixture SHA-256.
Visible-result timing records DOM state observed on an animation frame, not physical display scanout.
Cross-document elapsed times are never calculated.
cleanup_results: Nine practice objects retained, including six protected recovery objects. No automatic cleanup.
